snippet.title: Fuso's Meteor | Season 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Fuso's Meteor (formerly Project Meteor 2) is an RPG Maker XP fangame project. Please check out the thread on Eevee Expo, Pokécommunity, or join the Fuso's Meteor Discord for more information.

This is a non-profit fangame project. Please support the official games!
Music credits: Rewrite OP
Title logo: KioRaka, Sama
